# Function reference {.doc .doc-index}

## 1 Pipeline API

Stateful Combiner object and rejection objects.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Combiner](Combiner.qmd#imcombiners.Combiner) | Stateful pipeline holder for `(scale/zero, reject, combine)` workflows. |
| [SigClip](SigClip.qmd#imcombiners.SigClip) | Iterative sigma-clipping rejection. |
| [CcdClip](CcdClip.qmd#imcombiners.CcdClip) | CCD noise-model clipping. |
| [LinearClip](LinearClip.qmd#imcombiners.LinearClip) | Center-relative linear clipping. |
| [MinMaxClip](MinMaxClip.qmd#imcombiners.MinMaxClip) | Reject the smallest and largest unmasked values at each pixel. |
| [PClip](PClip.qmd#imcombiners.PClip) | IRAF-style percentile clipping. |
| [Rejector](Rejector.qmd#imcombiners.Rejector) | Base class for rejection objects. |
| [SampleFlags](SampleFlags.qmd#imcombiners.SampleFlags) | Per-sample rejection/provenance flags. |
| [OutputFlags](OutputFlags.qmd#imcombiners.OutputFlags) | Per-output rejection status flags. |
| [resolve_zero_scale](resolve_zero_scale.qmd#imcombiners.resolve_zero_scale) | Resolve a numeric, string, or callable zero/scale input. |

## 2 Kernel API

Advanced one-operation primitives for custom pipeline layers.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [kernels.nanaverage](kernels.nanaverage.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.nanaverage) | Return the NaN-aware weighted average along the stack axis. |
| [kernels.grow_mask](kernels.grow_mask.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.grow_mask) | Dilate a stack mask over spatial axes by an exact Euclidean radius. |
| [kernels.sigclip](kernels.sigclip.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.sigclip) | Sigma-clipping rejection. |
| [kernels.sigclip_1d](kernels.sigclip_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.sigclip_1d) | Sigma-clipping rejection (1-D variant). |
| [kernels.sigclip_mask](kernels.sigclip_mask.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.sigclip_mask) | Sigma-clipping rejection (mask-only variant). |
| [kernels.sigclip_combine](kernels.sigclip_combine.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.sigclip_combine) | Sigma-clipping rejection (output-only variant). |
| [kernels.sigclip_combine_1d](kernels.sigclip_combine_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.sigclip_combine_1d) | Sigma-clipping rejection (1-D output-only variant). |
| [kernels.ccdclip](kernels.ccdclip.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.ccdclip) | CCD noise-model clipping. |
| [kernels.ccdclip_1d](kernels.ccdclip_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.ccdclip_1d) | CCD noise-model clipping (1-D variant). |
| [kernels.ccdclip_mask](kernels.ccdclip_mask.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.ccdclip_mask) | CCD noise-model clipping (mask-only variant). |
| [kernels.ccdclip_mask_1d](kernels.ccdclip_mask_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.ccdclip_mask_1d) | CCD noise-model clipping (1-D mask-only variant). |
| [kernels.ccdclip_combine](kernels.ccdclip_combine.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.ccdclip_combine) | CCD noise-model clipping (output-only variant). |
| [kernels.ccdclip_combine_1d](kernels.ccdclip_combine_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.ccdclip_combine_1d) | CCD noise-model clipping (1-D output-only variant). |
| [kernels.linearclip](kernels.linearclip.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.linearclip) | Center-relative linear clipping (`low + low_scale * center <= value <= upp + upp_scale * center`). |
| [kernels.linearclip_1d](kernels.linearclip_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.linearclip_1d) | Center-relative linear clipping (`low + low_scale * center <= value <= upp + upp_scale * center`) (1-D variant). |
| [kernels.minmax](kernels.minmax.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.minmax) | Reject the `n_min` smallest and `n_max` largest unmasked values at each pixel. Single-pass. |
| [kernels.minmax_1d](kernels.minmax_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.minmax_1d) | Reject the `n_min` smallest and `n_max` largest unmasked values at each pixel. Single-pass (1-D variant). |
| [kernels.minmax_mask](kernels.minmax_mask.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.minmax_mask) | Reject the `n_min` smallest and `n_max` largest unmasked values at each pixel. Single-pass (mask-only variant). |
| [kernels.minmax_mask_1d](kernels.minmax_mask_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.minmax_mask_1d) | Reject the `n_min` smallest and `n_max` largest unmasked values at each pixel. Single-pass (1-D mask-only variant). |
| [kernels.minmax_combine](kernels.minmax_combine.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.minmax_combine) | Reject the `n_min` smallest and `n_max` largest unmasked values at each pixel. Single-pass (output-only variant). |
| [kernels.minmax_combine_1d](kernels.minmax_combine_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.minmax_combine_1d) | Reject the `n_min` smallest and `n_max` largest unmasked values at each pixel. Single-pass (1-D output-only variant). |
| [kernels.pclip](kernels.pclip.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.pclip) | IRAF-style percentile clipping at each pixel. |
| [kernels.pclip_1d](kernels.pclip_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.pclip_1d) | IRAF-style percentile clipping at each pixel (1-D variant). |
| [kernels.pclip_mask](kernels.pclip_mask.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.pclip_mask) | IRAF-style percentile clipping at each pixel (mask-only variant). |
| [kernels.pclip_mask_1d](kernels.pclip_mask_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.pclip_mask_1d) | IRAF-style percentile clipping at each pixel (1-D mask-only variant). |
| [kernels.pclip_combine](kernels.pclip_combine.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.pclip_combine) | IRAF-style percentile clipping at each pixel (output-only variant). |
| [kernels.pclip_combine_1d](kernels.pclip_combine_1d.qmd#imcombiners.kernels.pclip_combine_1d) | IRAF-style percentile clipping at each pixel (1-D output-only variant). |

## 3 Compatibility API

IRAF-style compact wrapper.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [ndcombine](ndcombine.qmd#imcombiners.ndcombine) | Combine an image stack with optional normalization and rejection. |
| [place_into_padded](place_into_padded.qmd#imcombiners.place_into_padded) | Place N-D arrays into a padded stack using integer offsets. |
